sources.ref: UX_Feedback_v4 item 14 (2026-10-05): teammate-nature suspicion check before debrief

notes: v2 appends tp_post_10 — a fixed-choice item asked immediately before debrief ('which best describes them?'). Choice items carry an options list; the recorded value is the option text.

Approved for live pilot fielding (2026-10-07, BA-99 audit remediation): body identical to the bound reference version; approved successor minted so the restored approved-only live gate binds only approved material.
Fielded post-task item set for the pilot (BA-99): items frozen under D06; approved successor minted so the live bind carries only approved material.

items.text: I had the information I needed to make good decisions.
There was important information that I did not have.
My teammates knew things that I did not.
The AI assistant was useful for this task.
Asking my teammates for information would have taken up time they did not have.
I expected my teammates to reply quickly if I asked them something.
My teammates were willing to help me.
My teammates seemed competent at the task.
After the check-in, I felt more rushed myself.
Thinking about the other two members of your team, which best describes them?
options: Some were human, some were automated
